author: Codex (AI visual review)
scope: Selected identifiable worker-machine pairs in 12 full-resolution images; no inference outputs consulted. Source captions and strata were available from prior sampling. Exploratory reference only. Unlisted pairs are unscored.

rows.evidence: Bent knees, feet in the footwell and seat directly behind the torso identify a seated occupant.
rows.uncertainty: Seat is visible. Control use and motion cannot be established.
rows.hazard_evidence: Cab occupancy alone supplies no specific exposure.

rows.worker: Red shirt at rear left of cab
rows.evidence: Head and upper torso appear beside the cab above the rear housing.
rows.uncertainty: Housing hides legs, feet and their support. The source describes standing on the loader; the exact support is unresolved in the photo.
rows.hazard_evidence: The person's footing and task are hidden.

rows.worker: Yellow helmet and dark clothing, left foreground
rows.evidence: Both feet are on rubble to the left of the bucket in the image.
rows.uncertainty: Depth and physical clearance from the bucket are uncertain.
rows.hazard_evidence: The bucket is visible near the worker in projection; its path and clearance cannot be established.

rows.evidence: Torso and bent legs occupy the operator station behind the front glass.
rows.uncertainty: The glass limits detail at the controls.
rows.hazard_evidence: A person in the operator station alone supplies no specific exposure.

rows.worker: White shirt cropped at right edge
rows.evidence: The person's shoulder and arm are visible in the foreground and the excavator is across the trench.
rows.uncertainty: Feet and distance from the bucket are outside or unresolved in the frame.
rows.hazard_evidence: The person's location relative to the bucket path is unclear.

rows.evidence: The person's back is against the seat, knees are bent, and feet are inside the cab.
rows.uncertainty: Machine movement and use of the controls are uncertain.
rows.hazard_evidence: The visible seated position alone supplies no specific exposure.

rows.worker: Distant blue figure behind tarps, left
rows.evidence: A small upper body is visible behind the railing and tarp to the left of the excavator.
rows.uncertainty: The tarp hides the lower body. The actual support surface and distance are unresolved.
rows.hazard_evidence: Occlusion and depth prevent judging exposure.

rows.evidence: The visible legs project against the dirt bank above the track. The boom obscures part of the body.
rows.uncertainty: The source describes standing on the track. The feet cannot be linked visually to that track; the exact support is unassessable.
rows.hazard_evidence: The worker projects close to the boom. Depth and clearance are unresolved.

rows.evidence: Legs extend to the dirt to the right of the bulldozer; the tracks are visible separately.
rows.uncertainty: Depth, machine movement and sight lines are uncertain.
rows.hazard_evidence: The photo establishes co-location without a specific contact or load exposure.

rows.worker: Small dark figure at far end of access road
rows.evidence: The upright figure is visible immediately left of the excavator in projection.
rows.uncertainty: Distance and image detail prevent a reliable support or clearance judgment.
rows.hazard_evidence: The person's position relative to the bucket path is unresolved.

rows.worker: Dark-clothed foreground worker, left of truck
rows.evidence: The worker stands on dirt beside the large rear wheel. The legs extend to the dirt below the wheel hub.
rows.uncertainty: Distance and vehicle movement are unresolved.
rows.hazard_evidence: The wheel is close in projection; actual clearance and travel direction are unknown.

rows.worker: Blue-clothed person at pipe mouth in trench
rows.evidence: Worker and corrugated pipe are visible below the rear excavator. The bucket is visible against the sky.
rows.uncertainty: Depth between the worker, boom and bucket cannot be established.
rows.hazard_evidence: The image does not resolve whether the bucket could reach this worker.

rows.worker: Upright person on left lip of trench, behind pipe
rows.evidence: A small upright figure appears along the left edge near the pipe; the excavator is behind it in the frame.
rows.uncertainty: Person is too small for precise footing, clearance or action.
rows.hazard_evidence: The relationship to the excavator's working area is unresolved.

rows.machine: Excavator with bucket extending into trench
rows.evidence: Person stands below the banks with arms extended to the sides. The bucket occupies the same narrow trench ahead of the worker.
rows.uncertainty: A still image cannot establish whether the bucket is moving or its exact distance.
rows.hazard_evidence: Potential struck-by or crushing exposure warrants review because the worker and bucket occupy the same confined trench.

rows.worker: Person in green trousers on upper bank
rows.evidence: Both sets of legs end on the upper dirt bank to the right of the machine.
rows.uncertainty: Upper bodies and their tasks are cropped. Their clearance is uncertain.
rows.hazard_evidence: The visible feet alone do not establish exposure to the bucket.

rows.worker: Person in light trousers on upper bank
rows.evidence: Both sets of legs end on the upper dirt bank to the right of the machine.
rows.uncertainty: Upper bodies and their tasks are cropped. Their clearance is uncertain.
rows.hazard_evidence: The visible feet alone do not establish exposure to the bucket.
